source.name: BasketFaul: Fenerbahçe'de BEKO'nun Yerine Tarfin (Anlaşma 2 Yıl)
source.quote: Anlaşmaya göre tarfin, Fenerbahçe’ye bonuslar dışında 7.5 milyon euro verecek.

note: Two-season name and chest sponsorship (2026/27 and 2027/28) replacing Beko. BasketFaul reports Tarfin will pay 7.5m euros excluding bonuses, plus 2.5m euros in bonuses tied to success in the BSL, the Turkish Cup and the EuroLeague; it doesn't say whether the 7.5m is per season or for the whole two-year deal, so value is left null.
